title: A Novel Hybrid Peptide VLP-Abeta Efficiently Regulates Immunity by Stimulating Myeloid Differentiation Protein and Activating the NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Wang, Junyong; Zhao, Xuelian; Zhang, Rijun; Zhang, Jing; Tong, Yucui; Abbas, Zaheer; Si, Dayong; Wei, Xubiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究杂合肽VLP-Abeta通过MD2激活TLR4-NF-kappaB通路的免疫调节作用，涉及蛋白-小分子肽对接与动力学模拟，但对象为肽-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Immunosuppression dramatically increases tissue and organ susceptibility to infection, injury, and even cancer. This poses a serious threat to human and animal health. In a previous study, we established a platform for high-throughput design and screening of multifunctional peptides. Using this platform, we successfully identified a novel hybrid peptide, VLP-Abeta (VA), which exhibits both immunomodulatory and antioxidant properties. This study aimed to evaluate the immunomodulatory activity of VA and investigate the underlying molecular mechanisms. In the cyclophosphamide (CTX)-induced immunodeficient mouse model, VA significantly alleviated CTX-induced weight loss. It also restored thymus and spleen indices, and increased serum immunoglobulins (IgA, IgM, IgG) and cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta) levels. VA also improved splenic lymphocyte proliferation, CD4(+)/CD8(+) T cell ratios, and NK cell cytotoxicity. At the cellular level, western blot analysis showed that VA activated the TLR4-NF-kappaB pathway in RAW264.7 macrophages. Mechanistically, inhibition of the MD2 protein by L6H21 abolished VA's immunomodulatory effects. This confirms MD2 as a critical mediator. Molecular docking and dynamics simulations revealed that VA binds stably to the hydrophobic pocket of MD2. These findings suggest that VA exerts immunomodulatory effects by stimulating MD2 and activating the TLR4-NF-kappaB pathway, which provides new ideas, techniques, and approaches for the development of novel peptide immunomodulators.
abstract_zh: 免疫抑制显著增加组织和器官对感染、损伤甚至癌症的易感性，对人类和动物健康构成严重威胁。在先前的研究中，我们建立了一个用于高通量设计和筛选多功能肽的平台。利用该平台，我们成功鉴定出一种新型杂合肽VLP-Abeta（VA），其兼具免疫调节和抗氧化特性。本研究旨在评估VA的免疫调节活性并探讨其潜在分子机制。在环磷酰胺（CTX）诱导的免疫缺陷小鼠模型中，VA显著缓解了CTX引起的体重下降，恢复胸腺和脾脏指数，并提高血清免疫球蛋白（IgA、IgM、IgG）和细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6、IL-1beta）水平。VA还改善了脾淋巴细胞增殖、CD4(+)/CD8(+) T细胞比例及NK细胞细胞毒性。在细胞水平上，western blot分析显示VA激活了RAW264.7巨噬细胞中的TLR4-NF-kappaB通路。机制上，通过L6H21抑制MD2蛋白可消除VA的免疫调节效应，这证实MD2是关键介导因子。分子对接和动力学模拟显示，VA稳定结合于MD2的疏水口袋。这些发现表明，VA通过刺激MD2并激活TLR4-NF-kappaB通路发挥免疫调节作用，为开发新型肽类免疫调节剂提供了新思路、新技术和新方法。
